findings.current: There’s less than a fortnight until the first of the month.
findings.defect: “A fortnight” means fourteen days, while 보름 means fifteen days. The English changes the stated time remaining.
findings.rationale: The source says 보름도 안 남았어: fewer than fifteen days remain.
findings.replacement: There are fewer than fifteen days until the first of the month.

summary: The chapter is faithful overall, with one minor timing-quantity shift.
